set.body:
Journey: See. Acceptance rehearsal with people. It begins only after the core gate (CORE) has closed, and we begin it believing it will pass.

Acceptance
1. A researcher from the second lab who has not used Sanctity signs in and, without help: finds the seeded multi-modal study by a phrase from its description; says who holds it and which data types it has; opens one MRI image and one table dictionary; and runs a query for participants who have both resting BOLD and EEG. Once SEE5 lands, the query adds a questionnaire score.
2. The time to each step and every hesitation is recorded as a note here. Anything that needed explaining becomes a note on the owning item or one new mvp item.
3. The same is repeated on the pilot instance with the real study once IN6 has passed.
